expects.query: Create an object segmentation pipeline using RF-DETR
checks: The delivered project contains runnable pipeline code or configuration, identifies its dependencies and model artifacts, and provides enough setup/run instructions to reproduce the demonstrated execution.
The pipeline loads and executes an RF-DETR model capable of object segmentation on sample input, with runtime evidence and captured output from that execution.

The delivered DeepStream pipeline successfully executes model inference on the GPU and produces output consistent with the expected result for the sample input, including empty detections when appropriate, with runtime evidence confirming that execution.

The output represents separate object instances with their masks and associated class information. Mask dimensions, encoding and coordinate mapping are defined and consistent with the input; a boxes-only result does not fulfill object segmentation.

The implementation preserves the association between each mask and its object through decoding and resizing, and handles empty instance results. Executed examples or focused tests demonstrate these behaviors; clearly identified fixtures may exercise cases absent from the sample input.
The demonstrated run completes or can be stopped cleanly, and input or inference errors are reported rather than presented as successful output.
